title: Ashvale Rising Revisited
author: Kestrel Crane
blurb: Sable Brightwater, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
